sub_graphs.title: EIP-2930: Access List Transaction Processing

nodes.label: Type 1 Transaction Received
nodes.description: An access list transaction (0x01 prefix) has been received

nodes.label: Decode EIP-2718 Envelope

nodes.label: Transaction Decoded
nodes.description: Transaction fields including access list have been parsed

nodes.label: Validate Access List Format
nodes.description: Verify access list matches [[{20 bytes}, [{32 bytes}...]...]...] structure

nodes.label: Access List Format Valid
nodes.description: Access list structure is correctly formatted

nodes.label: Access List Format Invalid

nodes.description: Verify signature over keccak256(0x01 || rlp([chainId, nonce, gasPrice, gasLimit, to, value, data, accessList]))

nodes.label: SLOAD Warm Access
nodes.description: SLOAD on prewarmed storage key costs only 100 gas

nodes.description: EXTCODESIZE/EXTCODECOPY/EXTCODEHASH on cold address costs 2600 gas

ambiguities.text: The specification mentions 'Duplicates are charged multiple times' but does not explicitly state whether this applies to both addresses and storage keys.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume duplicate charging applies to both: duplicate addresses cost 2400 each, duplicate storage keys cost 1900 each, with no benefit.

ambiguities.text: The 10% discount mentioned in security considerations is not formally specified in the gas cost section.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume the 10% discount refers to the difference between paying upfront (2400+1900) vs. cold access costs during execution (2600+2100).

ambiguities.text: No specification of maximum access list size or gas limit implications.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume access list size is bounded only by block gas limit; very large lists would consume all gas in intrinsic cost.

implicit_assumptions.description: Users or tools can accurately predict which addresses and storage keys a transaction will access.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Inaccurate access lists waste gas on unused warm slots or miss needed slots, reducing efficiency.

implicit_assumptions.description: The gas costs (2400 for addresses, 1900 for keys) provide meaningful savings compared to cold access during execution.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: If cold access costs change, the economics of access lists may become unfavorable.

implicit_assumptions.description: Attackers cannot use access lists to significantly increase block processing time beyond what gas costs cover.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Underpriced access list processing could enable DoS attacks through oversized access lists.

implicit_assumptions.description: Access list generation tools produce correct and complete access lists without security vulnerabilities.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Malicious or buggy tools could produce access lists that waste gas or miss critical storage accesses.
